name: DisplayInputDialogNode
label: Display Input Dialog
description: Displays a dialog box that prompts the user to enter text.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: InputDialogTitle
fields.label: Input Dialog Title
fields.description: The title text displayed at the top of the input dialog.

fields.name: InputDialogMessage
fields.label: Input Dialog Message
fields.description: The main text content of the input dialog.

fields.name: DefaultValue
fields.label: Default Value
fields.description: The default text pre-filled in the input field.

fields.name: InputType
fields.label: Input Type
fields.description: The type of input field (Text or Password).

fields.name: KeepOnTop
fields.label: Keep Input Dialog Always on Top
fields.description: If true, the input dialog will stay on top of other windows.

fields.name: UserInput
fields.label: User Input
fields.description: The text entered by the user.

fields.name: ButtonPressed
fields.label: Button Pressed
fields.description: The result indicating which button was pressed by the user.
